descriptionByLocale.it: Polizia: in polizia di trasporto 50-100% | FFS - - - - - - Sposta la Svizzera con noi. Polizia: in polizia di trasporto Basilea, d'ora in poi o d'accordo, 50-100 % Applicare ora ## Non vedo l'ora. Alla base strategicamente importante di Basilea, stiamo cercando diversi agenti di polizia come parte di un set-up. Rafforzate la squadra esistente e assicuratevi che le persone si sentano al sicuro nei trasporti pubblici con il lavoro di polizia cittadino-friendly. Invece della routine amministrativa, l'attenzione è sulla missione vicino all'azione – attraverso i confini cantonali e incorporato in un team forte e apprezzativo. Le condizioni di lavoro interessanti sono importanti per noi – anche per ore di lavoro irregolari. Grazie a periodi di riposo chiaramente regolamentati e solo alcuni servizi notturni, il lavoro e la vita privata possono essere ben riconciliati presso la Polizia di Trasporto delle FFS. Scegli il tuo carico di lavoro in modo flessibile tra il 40-100%, un requisito di residenza non esiste. Il lavoro notturno e il fine settimana è inoltre pagato, ad esempio CHF 16.- all'ora per il lavoro di domenica e supplementi di tempo del 10-30% per gli incarichi notturni. Ulteriori vantaggi, come il libero GA 2a classe, assegni per bambini e viaggi scontati in patria e all'estero – anche per la tua famiglia possono essere trovati sotto “Benefits”. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di ufficiale di polizia: nelle FFS di Polizia dei Trasporti, insieme a più di 200 colleghi, si garantisce la sicurezza, la pace e l'ordine nelle stazioni ferroviarie e nei trasporti pubblici da varie compagnie di trasporto in tutta la Svizzera. - Il vostro focus è sui servizi di pattugliamento uniformati in mezzi di trasporto, stazioni e sulle aree delle compagnie di trasporto. - Nel tuo ruolo, contribuisci significativamente alla sicurezza dei viaggiatori e del personale dei trasporti pubblici. - Nel caso di interventi di polizia, si assume responsabilità nel team e in collaborazione con le organizzazioni partner – anche in occasioni importanti. - Voi lavorate sulla situazione e siete sempre sull'impulso di ciò che accade nei trasporti pubblici. - Siete attivamente coinvolti nella costruzione del team e formarlo attivamente. Lo porti con te. - Come giocatore di squadra: apprezzi la cooperazione a livello degli occhi e contribuisci attivamente alla squadra. - Agite apertamente, rispettosamente e professionalmente e incontrate i clienti con una forte comprensione dei servizi. - Lei ha il passaporto federale agente di polizia: in io così come la polizia solida conoscenza tattica e tecnica. - Molto buone abilità tedesche orali e scritte ti distinguono; La conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale è un vantaggio. - Si utilizzano strumenti digitali in modo sicuro e responsabile e utilizzarli in modo mirato nell'uso quotidiano. ## La tua ricompensa e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale equo e progressivo e siamo attivamente impegnati a parità di retribuzione. Per questo motivo, ulteriori e dettagliate informazioni sul sistema salariale possono essere visualizzate in modo trasparente presso le FFS. Questo lavoro è nel livello di requisito H, Regional Allowance Livello 1. ## Questo è il punto di partenza. Il fatto che si desidera spostare la Svizzera con noi è la più grande motivazione per noi. Pertanto, ci asteniamo da una lettera di motivazione a questo punto. Se volete ancora dirci la vostra motivazione, avete ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di applicazione. Fare il grande è più facile per te. Questo inizia con la tua applicazione. ## E' cosi' che va. × Al più tardi 10 giorni lavorativi dopo aver ricevuto l'applicazione, riceverai un feedback iniziale da noi. Decisione finale fino a due mesi dopo la ricezione della domanda Applicazione Decisione finale fino a due mesi dopo la ricezione della domanda Ancora domande? Il processo di applicazione Supporto per il reclutamento delle FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 reclutamento@sbb.ch #SimplyYou # FAQ per l'applicazione Per lo scopo ID lavoro 103617 Michael Bigler, Base di Olten Telefono +41 79 876 95 69 Le applicazioni via e-mail non possono purtroppo essere considerate. Per questa posizione, non accettiamo i fascicoli dei reclutatori. ## Lo offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ovunque possibile, ci concentriamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di tempo di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo anche flessibili quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenuti Differenze benvenuti Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo una varietà impressionante di opportunità di ingresso e sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire ai loro punti di forza e ai loro modi di pensare individuali. Scopri di più Scopri di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Scopri di più Promuoviamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A questo scopo, forniamo una vasta gamma di offerte di formazione interdisciplinare e trasversale. Nella formazione esterna selezionata, partecipiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente. descriptionByLocale.en:
Policeman:in Transport Police 50-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Policeman:in Transportpolizei Basel, from now on or by appointment, 50-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to that. At the strategically important base in Basel, we are looking for several police officers as part of a set-up. You strengthen the existing team and ensure that people feel safe in public transport with citizen-friendly police work. Instead of administrative routine, the focus is on the mission close to the action – across cantonal borders and embedded in a strong, appreciative team. Attractive working conditions are important to us – even for irregular working hours. Thanks to clearly regulated rest periods and only a few night services, work and private life can be well reconciled with the SBB Transport Police. You choose your workload flexibly between 40-100%, a residence requirement does not exist. Night and weekend work is additionally remunerated, e.g. with CHF 16.- per hour for Sunday work and time surcharges of 10-30% for night assignments. Further benefits such as free GA 2nd class, child allowances and discounted travel at home and abroad - also for your family you can find under "Benefits". You can move that. - As a police officer: in the Transport Police SBB, together with more than 200 colleagues, you ensure security, peace and order in train stations and public transport from various transport companies throughout Switzerland. - Your focus is on uniformed patrol services in means of transport, railway stations and the areas of transport companies. In your role, you make a significant contribution to the safety of travellers and public transport staff. - In the case of police interventions, you carry responsibility in the team and in cooperation with partner organisations – even on major events. - You work situation-oriented and are always on the pulse of what is happening in public transport. - When building the team, you are actively involved and actively shape it. You bring that with you. - As a team player: you value cooperation at eye level and actively contribute to the team. - You act openly, respectfully and professionally and meet customers with a strong understanding of services. - You have the federal passport Police Officer: in I as well as sound police tactical and technical knowledge. - Very good oral and written German skills distinguish you; Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. You use digital tools safely and responsibly and use them in a targeted way in everyday use. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This job is in requirement level H, Regional Allowance Level 1. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. This starts with your application. ## Continue like this. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of the application, you will receive an initial feedback from us. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Still questions? For the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #simplyYou FAQ to apply For Job ID 103617 Michael Bigler, Chief Base Olten Telephone +41 79 876 95 69 Applications by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered. For this position, we do not accept dossiers from recruiters. ##
• We offer that. Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to reconciling your professional life with your private life. Read more Read more Differences Welcome Differences Welcome Read more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Learn More Learn More Career and Development Career and Development Learn More We promote our employees according to their personal needs and ambitions. For this purpose, we provide a wide range of interdisciplinary and cross-divisional training offers. In selected external training, we participate financially and temporally. Find out more about it

Officier de police:à la police des transports de Bâle, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 50-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Nous recherchons plusieurs policiers dans le cadre d'un projet de construction sur la base stratégiquement importante de Bâle. Vous renforcerez l'équipe existante et veillerez à ce que les gens se sentent en sécurité dans les transports publics grâce à la police de proximité. Au lieu de la routine administrative, l'accent est mis sur des opérations proches de l'action – au-delà des frontières cantonales et au sein d'une équipe solide et reconnaissante. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires irréguliers. Grâce à des temps de repos clairement réglementés et à quelques équipes de nuit seulement, travail et vie privée peuvent être facilement conciliés à la Police des Transports des CFF. Vous pouvez choisir votre charge de travail de manière flexible entre 40 et 100 %, il n'y a aucune obligation d'avoir un lieu de résidence. Le travail de nuit et de week-end est rémunéré en supplément, par ex. B. avec 16 CHF de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche ainsi que des majorations de temps de 10 à 30 % pour les équipes de nuit. D’autres avantages tels que l’AG 2e classe gratuite, les allocations familiales et les voyages à prix réduits en Suisse et à l’étranger – vous les trouverez également pour votre famille sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que policier de la police des transports des CFF, vous et plus de 200 collègues dans toute la Suisse veillez à la sécurité, à la tranquillité et à l'ordre dans les gares et les transports publics auprès de différentes entreprises de transport. - Votre attention se porte sur les services de patrouille en uniforme dans les moyens de transport, les gares et sur les zones des entreprises de transport. - Dans votre rôle, vous apportez une contribution significative à la sécurité des voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Lors des interventions policières, vous serez responsable de l'équipe et en collaboration avec les organismes partenaires - même lors d'événements majeurs. - Vous travaillez de manière orientée situation et êtes toujours à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics. - Vous participerez activement à la constitution de l'équipe et à sa formation. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous appréciez travailler ensemble sur un pied d'égalité et contribuer activement à l'équipe. - Vous apparaissez ouvert, respectueux et professionnel et rencontrez des clients avec une solide compréhension du service. - Vous possédez le brevet d'officier de la Police fédérale I ainsi que des connaissances tactiques et techniques policières approfondies. - Vous vous caractérisez par de très bonnes compétences en allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit ; La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous utilisez les outils numériques de manière sûre et responsable et les utilisez de manière ciblée dans les opérations quotidiennes. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence H, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Rangierbahnhof Basel im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund sechs bis acht Bildschirmen. Zusätzlich stellst du über ein Drucktastenstellwerk die verschiedenen Rangier- und Zugfahrten. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung bist du im Rangierbahnhof Basel tätig und hilfst dabei, dass 2000 Güterzüge täglich sicher und pünktlich ihr Ziel erreichen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Infoveranstaltung .
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Sonntagsarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland – auch für die Familie – findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.

Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in im Rangierbahnhof Basel behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst Züge sicher und ökologisch und überwachst den Verkehr.
- Im Regelbetrieb stellst du sicher, dass die internationalen Durchfahrten von Güterzügen (Deutschland – Frankreich) reibungslos durchgeführt werden.
- Bei Störungen leitest du Massnahmen ein, damit der Normalzustand wiederhergestellt wird.
- Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokpersonal sowie Bau- und Rangierpersonal in der Schweiz. Zudem stimmst du dich mit den Zugverkehrsleitenden des grenzüberschreitenden Güterverkehrs ab.
- Du verantwortest die Kundeninformation an Bahnhöfen und sorgst für klare, zeitnahe Mitteilungen.
- Dank deinem Einsatz sind Personen- und Güterzüge rund um die Uhr sicher und pünktlich unterwegs.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne im Team und bist bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du denkst strukturiert und vernetzt. In Stresssituationen handelst du schnell und überlegt. Die technische Affinität wird in der Ausbildung gefördert.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft mit und bist motiviert, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – vom Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs und bringst idealerweise Französisch auf Niveau A1 mit. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale: a Muttenz, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, tieni d'occhio la rete di tratte che ti è stata assegnata nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea, dirigi e monitori i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa sei-otto schermi. Inoltre è possibile impostare le diverse corse di manovra e dei treni tramite una pulsantiera. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto proceda senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea e contribuirai a garantire che 2000 treni merci arrivino ogni giorno a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Muttenz, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you in the Basel marshalling yard, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around six to eight screens. In addition, you can set the various shunting and train journeys using a push-button signal box. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the Basel marshalling yard and help ensure that 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start dates: - February 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can make this happen. - As a train traffic manager in the Basel marshalling yard, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operations, you ensure that the international transits of freight trains (Germany – France) are carried out smoothly. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel in Switzerland. You will also coordinate with the train traffic managers for cross-border freight transport. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are confident in German at level C2 and ideally have French at level A1. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Responsable du trafic des trains à entrée latérale : à Muttenz, sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué dans la gare de triage de Bâle, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ six à huit écrans. De plus, vous pouvez régler les différents trajets de manœuvres et de trains à l'aide d'un boîtier de signalisation à bouton-poussoir. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Nous vous proposons une formation secondaire rémunérée pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, d'une durée de huit mois. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous travaillerez dans la gare de triage de Bâle et contribuerez chaque jour à ce que 2000 trains de marchandises arrivent à destination en toute sécurité et à temps. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et le dimanche, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous assurerez également la coordination avec les gestionnaires du trafic ferroviaire pour le transport transfrontalier de marchandises. - Vous êtes responsable de l'information des clients dans les gares et assurez des communications claires et rapides. - Grâce à vos efforts, les trains de voyageurs et de marchandises circulent en toute sécurité et à l'heure 24 heures sur 24. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes fiable, aimez travailler en équipe et êtes prêt à travailler 24 heures sur 24. - Vous réfléchissez de manière structurée et en réseau. Dans les situations stressantes, vous agissez rapidement et prudemment. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous maîtrisez l'allemand au niveau C2 et possédez idéalement le français au niveau A1. Le document peut être commandé lorsque vous êtes invités à faire connaissance personnellement. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. descriptionByLocale.it: Gestore circolazione treni ingresso laterale: al 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale: a Olten, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria tieni d'occhio la rete di tratte che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi e monitori i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa otto schermi. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto proceda senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai presso la centrale operativa di Olten e contribuirai a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Olten, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work at the operations center in Olten and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start dates: - February 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can make this happen. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are confident in German at level C2 and ideally have French at level A1. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund acht Bildschirmen. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Dans les situations stressantes, vous agissez rapidement et prudemment. At SBB Cargo, you are on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 170,000 tons a day, relieving road traffic of 15,000 trucks per day and the environment of 460,000 tons of CO2 per year. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you move the SBB Cargo together with your teammates. In addition, you will receive a varied and paid training in the marshalling station. In addition, various further training opportunities are open to you, such as training as a shunting engine driver: inn. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even for irregular working hours. Night and weekend work is also paid for with us - for example with 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night assignments, you also get time surcharges between 10 and 30%. This means that you have more free time than employees without night and weekend assignments. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time by preparing freight trains for their journey. - You take over the cars, carry out security checks and prepare the train through complex shunting movements for the next journey. - You collect the necessary data for the train with personal, modern IT devices (e.g. tablet). - Due to the timely delivery and parking of the cars with the customer, you have direct customer contact every day. You receive their feedback and forward it to the responsible body if necessary. Here you will learn more about the job profile. You bring that with you. - You are attentive, focused and physically resilient to successfully handle this demanding work in 24-hour shift operations. You also like to work outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around with digital tools. Ideally, you have completed a basic training or already have professional experience in the crafts, logistical or comparable field. - You can communicate well orally and in writing in German (min. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
SBB Telecom verantwortet als privater Mobile Provider eine eigene, bahnkritische Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für den operativen Bahnbetrieb. Dazu gehören heute GSM-R, IMS und weitere bahnspezifische Kommunikationsdienste – und künftig FRMCS auf Basis von 5G.
Im Team BAK-Core gestalten und entwickeln wir die zentrale Kommunikationsplattform der SBB weiter. IMS spielt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: als Service- und Kommunikationsplattform für Sprachdienste, SIP-basierte Kommunikation, Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Netzen sowie als Grundlage für künftige Mission-Critical-Services im FRMCS-Umfeld.
Die Weiterentwicklung dieser Systeme ist ein strategisches Zukunftsthema mit hoher Bedeutung für die Digitalisierung und Sicherheit des Bahnbetriebs. Dich erwartet eine Rolle mit fachlichem Tiefgang, langfristiger Perspektive und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld. Dabei arbeitest du nicht an isolierten Einzelsystemen, sondern an einer umfassenden privaten Mobilfunk- und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur, die den sicheren Bahnbetrieb der Schweiz unterstützt.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits .
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du erhebst, strukturierst und dokumentierst Anforderungen an IMS-basierte Kommunikationsdienste im bahnkritischen Umfeld.
- Die Erarbeitung von technischen Konzepten, Zielbildern, Systemdesigns und Integrationsvorgaben für IMS, Voice Services, SIP-basierte Kommunikations- und Mission-Critical-Kommunikationsdienste gehört zu deinen Tätigkeiten.
- In dieser Rolle übersetzt du betriebliche, technische und sicherheitsrelevante Anforderungen in Spezifikationen, Lastenhefte und Ausschreibungsunterlagen.
- Du beurteilst Lösungsdesigns von Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass diese den funktionalen, technischen und betrieblichen Anforderungen entsprechen.
- Du definierst und überprüfst die Integration von IMS in eine komplexe Systemlandschaft mit GSM-R, 4G/5G-Komponenten, Core-Netzen, MCX und betrieblichen Umsystemen und begleitest die entsprechenden Life-Cycle-Vorhaben fachlich.
- Lieferanten begleitest du von der Spezifikation über die Realisierung bis zur Einführung und arbeitest dabei eng mit internen Fachstellen, Betrieb, Engineering, Architektur, Einkauf sowie externen Partnern zusammen.
Das bringst du mit.
- Mit analytischer und strukturierter Arbeitsweise vermittelst du technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und verknüpfst unterschiedliche Anforderungen. Du hast Freude am Lernen und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein.
- Du arbeitest gerne im Team und führst Lieferanten fachlich sicher durch Ausschreibungen sowie durch Lasten und Pflichtenhefte. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Telekommunikations-, Mobilfunk- oder Kommunikationsumfeld gesammelt oder bist motiviert, dich in dieses Themengebiet einzuarbeiten. Idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie Requirements Engineering, System Engineering, technischer Spezifikation, Systemdesign oder Integrationsmanagement mit.
- Interesse an Kommunikationsplattformen, Sprachdiensten, Schnittstellen und deren Zusammenspiel; Erfahrungen mit IMS-Architekturen, SIP, VoLTE oder Mission-Critical-Services sind von Vorteil.
- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
- Vorausgesetzt werden sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2) oder die Bereitschaft, diese entsprechend aufzubauen.

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau L, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Quereinstieg Lokführer:in Personenverkehr Ziegelbrücke 12/2026
Ziegelbrücke, 01.12.2026, 100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Lokführer:in machst du Grosses: Bei SBB Personenverkehr bewegst du jährlich rund 508 Millionen Reisende. Nach Abschluss der bezahlten 15-monatigen Zweitausbildung führt dich der Job entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz. Dabei bringst du unsere Fahrgäste pünktlich an ihr Ziel und sorgst so für ein positives Reiseerlebnis mit der SBB.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, da du deine Freizeit geniessen kannst, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht. Ausserdem kannst du nach der Ausbildung zum:zur Lokführer:in dein Pensum nach Rücksprache individuell ab 60 Prozent gestalten, wobei dir unterschiedliche Teilzeitmodelle zur Verfügung stehen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Informationsveranstaltung .
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführer:in übernimmst du nicht nur die Spitze des Zugs, sondern auch Verantwortung für Sicherheit und Pünktlichkeit auf dem dicht befahrenen Schienennetz.
- Während deiner Fahrt bist du achtsam und reagierst schnell und richtig auf Signale, Geschwindigkeitsregelungen sowie unvorhersehbare Ereignisse.
- Du handelst selbstständig und stehst jederzeit mit Betriebszentralen und Leitstellen in Kontakt.
- Neben dem Führen und Rangieren der Züge gehört auch das Überprüfen des technischen Zustands vor und nach der Übernahme des Fahrzeugs zu deinen Aufgaben.
- Dank dem exakt getakteten Dienstplan kannst du pünktlich und ohne weitere Aufgaben oder Mails in den wohlverdienten Feierabend.
Das bringst du mit.
- Herausforderungen gehst du gelassen an, triffst auch in stressigen Situationen überlegte Entscheidungen und bringst Bereitschaft für Schichtarbeit mit.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Motivation mit und bist bereit, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – von Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (Niveau C2) und bringst Anfängerkenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache (Niveau A1) mit.
- Aus Sicherheitsgründen verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot-Grün-Schwäche). Zudem weist du keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.

Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start date: - March 1, 2027 - July 1, 2027 - November 1, 2027 You can move this. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - In German you are confident at level C2. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience in Erstfeld, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103356 Christian Diener Telephone +41 79 505 05 94 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Un programme de formation varié et rémunéré à temps plein de 9 mois vous attend. Vous complétez votre formation théorique à Olten ou à Zurich et acquérez votre première expérience pratique dans une gare de triage régionale. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels qu'une AG gratuite, des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages et vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le poste ici. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de trains de chantier, vous contribuez grandement à assurer le renouvellement des voies (voies, graviers, etc.). - Vous effectuez et réalisez en toute autonomie des mouvements de manœuvre divers et complexes de trains jusqu'à un maximum de 100 km/h, les formez, les démontez et les préparez au voyage. - Afin d'assurer la logistique régionale, vous rédigez, demandez et commandez à temps les ordres de conduite et êtes responsable de l'approvisionnement des chantiers en matériel nécessaire. - Vous avez un haut niveau de responsabilité quant à la sécurité opérationnelle des trains de chantier. Le contrôle de la sécurité sur le lieu de travail et la création de rapports complètent les activités. - De plus, vous serez déployé en tant que conducteur de train pour des trains de chantier sur le chantier et vos compétences techniques seront requises. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes consciencieux, fiable, avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts de 24 heures. - Vous êtes physiquement et mentalement résilient et pouvez agir consciemment et correctement grâce à votre façon de travailler indépendante. - Vous disposez d'au moins deux années de formation professionnelle reconnue comprenant un certificat de compétence, idéalement dans le secteur de la construction et avec une expérience en construction de voies ou avez complété votre diplôme d'études secondaires. - La maîtrise de l'allemand écrit et parlé (niveau C1) est un prérequis. - Vous possédez un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge/vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. You can move that. - Your main task is to independently carry out maintenance, renewal and troubleshooting work on all cable systems. - You report the work carried out and record working times and expenses. - In this role you will splice copper and fiber optic cables, lay cables and carry out the necessary assembly work. - As head of security, you occasionally monitor compliance with security measures in accordance with the security policy. - For work preparation on the work or construction site, you order materials and coordinate their deliveries. This is what you bring with you. - Your high sense of responsibility and safety will enable you to familiarize yourself well and thoroughly with your new job in the SBB environment. You enjoy working primarily outdoors in all seasons. - Due to our safety regulations, it is important that you are in good health with full hearing and vision. - You have a certificate of skills (EFZ) from the craft sector, preferably from the electrical industry (e.g. electrician, electrician). - Willingness to be trained to become a head of security. - A category B driving license completes your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. Olten, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Auf dich wartet ein spannendes, innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du grosse Veränderungen antreiben kannst und so zur Digitalisierung der SBB beiträgst. Bei UHR (Unterhalt Rollmaterial) wirst du eine Schlüsselposition im Werk Olten haben, mit vielen Aufgaben, Verantwortungen, um unsere Kunden mit deinem vollen Einsatz zu unterstützen. Gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen erarbeitest du Lösungswege für aktuelle Herausforderungen und setzt diese im Team um. Auch Weiterbildungen kommen für die individuelle Berufsentwicklung nicht zu kurz.
Im Werk Olten arbeitest du aktuell im Zweischichtbetrieb von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 04.45 Uhr und 17.45 Uhr.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Rangierspezialist:in bewegst du unter Anleitung des Manöverkoordinators Reise- und Güterzugwagen.
- In dein Tätigkeitsgebiet gehört u.a. das An- und Abhängen der verschiedenen Wagen und die Bedienung der Handweichen sowie dem Stellwerk. Dabei arbeitest du nach den Fahrdiendienstvorschriften und den vorgeschriebenen Standards der SBB.
- Inbetriebnahmen von und fahren mit Trieb- und Gliederzügen gehören ebenfalls in deinen Aufgabenbereich.
- Du fährst mit Rangierlokomotiven, Zweiwegefahrzeugen, führst Bremsproben durch und erstellst die Fahrbereitschaft. Zudem bist du für den Kleinunterhalt der Fahrzeuge zuständig.
- Kundenzufriedenheit ist eines unserer obersten Ziele. Für unsere Kunden bist du täglich im Einsatz. Du lebst unsere Sicherheitskultur und wendest den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) konstant an.
Das bringst du mit.
- Damit du diese verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe erfolgreich wahrnehmen kannst, bist du geistig und körperlich fit und in guter Verfassung.
- Du zeichnest dich durch dein vernetztes Denken und Handeln, deine Belastbarkeit, deine Selbstständigkeit sowie deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, aus.
- Ausgeprägtes Teamplay sowie eine überdurchschnittlich hohe Kunden- und Qualitätsorientierung sind weitere Attribute, die deinen Charakter gut beschreiben.
- Für die anspruchsvolle Position benötigst du eine abgeschlossene Grundausbildung EFZ, idealerweise als Logistiker:in Verkehr oder eine ähnliche Ausbildung in handwerklicher/technischer Richtung.
- Du verfügst idealerweise über eine Ausbildung und Erfahrung im Rangierdienst, verbunden mit fahrdienstlichem Begleiten gemäss BAV Ausweis VTE A40 direkt. Alternativ bist du Rangierbegleiter:in Ai40 indirekt und bringst die Bereitschaft zur Ausbildung VTE A40 direkt mit.
- Du bringst gute schriftliche und mündliche Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch mit (mindestens Niveau B2).

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau E, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. descriptionByLocale.it: Macchinista: in manovra o specialista di manovra: nel 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Macchinista: in manovra o specialista in manovra: a Olten, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante e innovativo in cui potrete guidare grandi cambiamenti e contribuire così alla digitalizzazione delle FFS. In UHR (manutenzione materiale rotabile) avrai una posizione chiave nello stabilimento di Olten, con molti compiti e responsabilità per supportare i nostri clienti con il tuo pieno impegno. Insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, svilupperai soluzioni alle sfide attuali e le implementerai come una squadra. Anche la formazione continua non viene trascurata per lo sviluppo professionale individuale. Nello stabilimento di Olten attualmente lavorate su due turni dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 4:45 alle 17:45. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, sposti vagoni passeggeri e merci sotto la guida del coordinatore di manovra. - La tua area di attività comprende, tra le altre cose, il fissaggio e lo sgancio dei vari carri e l'azionamento degli interruttori manuali e della cassetta di segnalazione. Lavorate nel rispetto delle prescrizioni del servizio di trasporto e degli standard prescritti dalle FFS. - Anche la messa in servizio e la guida di più unità e treni articolati rientrano nella vostra area di responsabilità. - Guidi locomotive da manovra, veicoli strada-rotaia, effettui prove di frenata e ti assicuri che siano pronti per la guida. Sei anche responsabile della piccola manutenzione dei veicoli. - La soddisfazione del cliente è uno dei nostri obiettivi principali. Lavori per i nostri clienti ogni giorno. Vivi la nostra cultura della sicurezza e applichi costantemente il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP). Questo è quello che porti con te. - Affinché tu possa svolgere con successo questo compito di responsabilità, devi essere mentalmente e fisicamente in forma e in buona forma. - Sei caratterizzato dal tuo pensiero e dalle tue azioni in rete, dalla tua resilienza, dalla tua indipendenza e dalla tua volontà di assumerti la responsabilità. - Un forte gioco di squadra, un orientamento al cliente e alla qualità superiore alla media sono ulteriori attributi che descrivono bene il tuo carattere. - Per la posizione impegnativa è necessario aver completato la formazione di base EFZ, preferibilmente come specialista della logistica nei trasporti o una formazione simile in ambito artigianale/tecnico. - Idealmente avete formazione ed esperienza nel campo delle manovre, abbinate all'accompagnamento di guida secondo la carta d'identità BAV VTE A40 direct. In alternativa sei addetto di manovra Ai40 indirettamente e sei disposto a partecipare alla formazione VTE A40. - Possiedi buone competenze linguistiche scritte e orali in tedesco (almeno livello B2). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito E, livello di indennità regionale 0. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione finale Domanda Decisione finale Domande? Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An exciting, innovative working environment awaits you in which you can drive big changes and thus contribute to the digitalization of SBB. At UHR (maintenance rolling stock) you will have a key position in the Olten plant, with many tasks and responsibilities in order to support our customers with your full commitment. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. At the Olten plant you are currently working in two shifts from Monday to Friday between 4:45 a.m. and 5:45 p.m. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you move passenger and freight train cars under the guidance of the maneuver coordinator. - Your area of ​​activity includes, among other things, attaching and detaching the various wagons and operating the manual switches and the signal box. You work in accordance with the transport service regulations and the prescribed standards of the SBB. - Commissioning and driving multiple units and articulated trains are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. - You drive shunting locomotives, road-rail vehicles, carry out brake tests and ensure that they are ready to drive. You are also responsible for the small maintenance of the vehicles. - Customer satisfaction is one of our top goals. You work for our customers every day. You live our safety culture and constantly apply the continuous improvement process (CIP). This is what you bring with you. - In order for you to be able to carry out this responsible task successfully, you must be mentally and physically fit and in good shape. - You are characterized by your networked thinking and actions, your resilience, your independence and your willingness to take responsibility. - Strong team play as well as an above-average customer and quality orientation are further attributes that describe your character well. - For the demanding position, you need to have completed basic EFZ training, ideally as a logistics specialist in transport or similar training in a craft/technical direction. - Ideally, you have training and experience in shunting, combined with driving accompaniment in accordance with the BAV ID card VTE A40 direct. Alternatively, you are an Ai40 shunting attendant indirectly and are willing to take part in VTE A40 training. - You have good written and oral language skills in German (at least level B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103360 Erich Huser Telephone +41 79 894 00 43 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

descriptionByLocale.fr: Conducteur de train : en manœuvre ou spécialiste des manœuvres : en 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Conducteur de train : en manœuvres ou spécialiste des manœuvres : à Olten, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant vous attend dans lequel vous pouvez conduire de grands changements et ainsi contribuer à la numérisation des CFF. Chez UHR (maintenance du matériel roulant), vous occuperez un poste clé au sein de l'usine d'Olten, avec de nombreuses tâches et responsabilités afin d'accompagner nos clients avec votre plein engagement. Avec vos coéquipiers, vous développerez des solutions aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. La formation continue n’est pas non plus négligée pour le développement professionnel individuel. À l'usine d'Olten, vous travaillez actuellement en deux équipes du lundi au vendredi entre 4h45 et 17h45. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous déplacez des wagons de voyageurs et de marchandises sous la direction du coordonnateur des manœuvres. - Votre domaine d'activité comprend entre autres l'attelage et le détachement des différents wagons ainsi que la manoeuvre des interrupteurs manuels et du poste de signalisation. Vous travaillez conformément aux prescriptions relatives aux services de transport et aux normes prescrites par les CFF. - La mise en service et la conduite d'unités multiples et de trains articulés font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité. - Vous conduisez des locomotives de manœuvre, des véhicules rail-route, effectuez des tests de freinage et vous assurez qu'ils sont prêts à rouler. Vous êtes également responsable du petit entretien des véhicules. - La satisfaction du client est l'un de nos principaux objectifs. Vous travaillez chaque jour pour nos clients. Vous vivez notre culture de sécurité et appliquez constamment le processus d’amélioration continue (CIP). C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour que vous puissiez mener à bien cette tâche responsable, vous devez être en bonne forme mentale et physique. - Vous vous caractérisez par votre réflexion et vos actions en réseau, votre résilience, votre indépendance et votre volonté de prendre des responsabilités. - Un fort esprit d'équipe ainsi qu'une orientation client et qualité supérieure à la moyenne sont d'autres attributs qui décrivent bien votre caractère. - Pour le poste exigeant, vous devez avoir suivi une formation de base EFZ, idéalement en tant que logisticien dans le transport ou une formation similaire dans un sens artisanal/technique. - Idéalement, vous disposez d'une formation et d'une expérience en manœuvres, combinées à un accompagnement à la conduite conformément à la carte d'identité BAV VTE A40 direct. Alternativement, vous êtes indirectement opérateur de manœuvre Ai40 et souhaitez participer à la formation VTE A40. - Vous disposez de bonnes compétences linguistiques écrites et orales en allemand (au moins niveau B2). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Capoturno: a Transport Oensingen, 1 settembre 2026 o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce il carico sulle strade di 15.000 viaggi di camion al giorno e riduce l'impatto sull'ambiente di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 ogni anno. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui voi e i vostri collaboratori potrete far progredire FFS Cargo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di capoturno, sei responsabile della gestione operativa durante il turno che ti è stato assegnato e rappresenti il ​​caposquadra durante questo periodo. - Nel team sei responsabile della gestione operativa del personale, dei treni e dei mezzi. Fornisci istruzioni funzionali e le assegni secondo necessità al gruppo che è la tua area di responsabilità. - Ti assicuri che le regole e i processi di sicurezza, nonché la puntualità e la sicurezza, siano rispettati durante la preparazione dei treni nella tua zona. - In caso di deviazioni, agirai in modo indipendente per mantenere il più basso possibile l'impatto sui clienti e sulle operazioni. - In caso di incidente rappresentate gli interessi di FFS Cargo. Sulla base delle tue osservazioni, fornisci informazioni importanti su come migliorare i processi e l'utilizzo delle risorse. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Ti piace lavorare in squadra e rispettare le diverse personalità, lavori in modo indipendente e trovi rapidamente una buona soluzione, anche in situazioni difficili. Ti impegni attivamente per la sicurezza dei tuoi colleghi e sei un modello nella vita di tutti i giorni. - Possiedi competenze sociali e professionali complete. Apprezzi prendere decisioni in situazioni impreviste. - Sono richieste una formazione professionale completa o un'esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore delle manovre, nonché una buona padronanza della lingua locale. - L'utilizzo sicuro di Office 365 è per voi una cosa ovvia, così come l'applicazione delle norme sull'orario di lavoro della GAV e dell'AZG. - Hai molta esperienza nelle manovre. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS.
